title: MPESB MP Van Rakshak & Kshetra Rakshak Admit Card 2026 – Jail Prahari PET / Exam Schedule
postName: MP Van Rakshak, Kshetra Rakshak, Jail Prahari and Jail Superintend
vacancyDetails: Total vacancies: 1679 posts across MP Van Rakshak, Kshetra Rakshak, Jail Prahari and Jail Superintend recruitment 2026.
qualification: Class 10th passed for Van Rakshak, Kshetra Rakshak and Jail Prahari posts; bachelor degree for Jail Superintend. Physical standards and PET requirements apply as notified by MPESB.
ageLimit: Minimum age: 18 years for all posts except Jail Superintend (21 years minimum). Maximum age: 33 years as per the notified recruitment rules. Age relaxation as applicable.
applicationFee: General / Other State: Rs. 560; OBC / SC / ST: Rs. 310; portal charges: Rs. 60. Payment through e-challan, debit card, credit card or net banking.
selectionProcess: Application form → Physical Measurement Test / Physical Efficiency Test → Written examination / CBT as applicable → Document verification → Final merit list
documentsRequired: Recent photograph, signature, educational certificates, category certificate if required, valid ID proof and other documents mentioned in the official notification.
howToApply:
1. Visit the MPESB or MPOnline examination portal.
2. Open the MP Van Rakshak / Kshetra Rakshak / Jail Prahari recruitment 2026 form.
3. Register using your mobile number and email ID.
4. Fill the application form, upload documents and pay the fee.
5. Review the application carefully and submit it.
6. Download and save the final confirmation page.
shortDescription: MPESB has issued the admit card and PET schedule notice for MP Van Rakshak, Kshetra Rakshak, Jail Prahari and Jail Superintend recruitment 2026.
content:
Madhya Pradesh Employee Selection Board (MPESB) has released the admit card and PET schedule for the MP Van Rakshak, Kshetra Rakshak, Jail Prahari and Jail Superintend combined recruitment test 2026.

This notice includes the admit card release date, PET scheduling information, application dates, and other important exam-related updates.

Important dates

  • Application begin: 28 February 2026
  • Last date to apply online: 30 April 2026
  • Last date to pay fee: 30 April 2026
  • Correction last date: 30 April 2026
  • Admit card available: 27 May 2026
  • Exam date start: 04 June 2026
  • Answer key: 22 June 2026
  • Result status: Notified Soon

Vacancy details

MP Van Rakshak: 728 posts
Kshetra Rakshak: 169 posts
Jail Prahari: 757 posts
Jail Superintend: 25 posts

Admit card and PET

Candidates should download their admit card from the official MPESB portal before the examination. PET schedule details and other exam instructions are available in the official notice and PDF links.
